edits.new: Record one open-ended question per direction, naming both nodes. For a child about one particular entity, test information about that same entity; establish any property needed for the test from the supplied meaning or necessary implications. If coverage hinges on an unknown property, ask what establishes it instead of assigning a hypothetical value. For a general child, describe a concrete potential case testing any applicable parent condition or permitted connection while attempting to preserve every child requirement. State the attempted violation; the question proves neither admission nor exclusion.
edits.old: Record one open-ended question per direction, naming both nodes and describing a concrete potential case. Any applicable parent condition or connection may be tested. State the attempted violation and attempt to preserve every child requirement; the question proves neither admission nor exclusion.
